checks: Exactly one accepted darrow.route_applied event exists per accepted candidate stream.
Each accepted event's selected and effective route equals the runner routeApplication record.
Each policy-sourced route matches the bundled mapping for its named profile.
Each terminal final_answer equals the runner resultText.
Each stream contains exactly one complete native-goal update.
Each final cumulative token-usage event equals the runner input/output token fields.
Every deterministic and protocol check passed for the accepted trials.
Each parsed judge score equals its recorded assessment.

rejectedRuns.reason: The classifier route was incorrectly fed back as a user override.
The parent did not wait for the nested launcher and self-reported completion.
The nested launch used an unset shell variable for the goal contract path.
Recursive Codex model discovery timed out, demonstrating that nested CLI recursion is not a reliable primary boundary.
The app-server rejected an invalid structured-output schema before model work.
Native goals cannot be attached to an ephemeral app-server thread.
The native goal completed on an automatic continuation turn, but the adapter waited on the original turn id.
The adapter parsed a commentary message as the final preflight handoff and applied Terra/low.
The handoff named deep but selected Sol/medium. It was excluded and replaced after policy-route validation was added.

conclusions.routeApplication: Verified. A Terra/low preflight selected and the host applied Sol/medium or Sol/high on every accepted task; selected and effective routes matched in the raw logs.
conclusions.profileIntegrity: Verified by post-hoc mapping audit for the first three tasks and live policy-source enforcement for the go-git replacement. The initially accepted deep/medium go-git handoff was detected, excluded, and replaced by deep/high.
conclusions.quality: All deterministic checks passed, but the blind judge rejected Click for a plausible unflushed-text interleaving defect. Treat qualitative success as 3/4, not 4/4.
conclusions.value: Not demonstrated. This N=1 routed cell is not causally comparable to historical gpt-5.5/medium controls, and deep routing did not prevent the Click defect.
conclusions.performance: The accepted composite averaged 240.3 seconds and 627,552 candidate tokens. These figures include the Terra/low preflight plus the routed native goal and no nested-child usage.
conclusions.status: Keep adaptive profile routing exploratory. Do not promote a value claim until vanilla and raw-native controls run on the same per-task effective routes for at least three trials.

controls: vanilla on each task's effective Sol route
raw native goal on each task's effective Sol route
Darrow preflight with Terra/low classification and policy-routed execution
